doc: What scripts/vehicle-bindings.py treats as expected by design, so its audit lists only what needs a look (Framework 0.258.0). partlyBound (28 Nov 2026): a role a system names that may go unbound, on the kinds or system given.

coverLike.why: The cab role falls back to the roof on armoured vehicles with no cab part: the crew sit under it (Loadouts_Default.xml).

partlyBound.why: The shared service system names a radiator and a drive belt for piston engines; a turbine aircraft has neither.
As the radiator: no accessory drive belt on a turbine.
The fuel tank is found by name and never added: a vehicle whose author drew no tank part has none to hole (Loadouts_Default.xml).
Submarine work is on the owner's back burner (20 Nov 2026): no reviews until it is picked up again.
An electric vehicle's auxiliary electrics name a starter from the combustion system they share; there is no engine to crank.
As above: nothing to crank on an electric vehicle.
An electric drive has no accessory drive belt.
The electric loadout writes no radiator part: an electric drive's cooling is not modelled by a part of its own (agent's reading, the owner to revise).

unwatched.why: No system of ours models springs or dampers; heavy-duty springs fit on the wheels.
Wiring is a flight-control or rig part read through its stat, with no system of its own.
Our own work parts (pumps, rigs, drills, dive gear) are read through their own stats by their comps.
Intakes (a fuel intake, the Harrier's intakes and compressor) are read through their stat; no system of ours models them.
